descriptions.w3d_d24g_energy_bar_set_team_80064384: Selects the energy bar team: when the team colour at +60 of the team record differs from the stored one, stores the team and colour, fills the +36 text with the team name and opaque black, reloads the bar texture HUD.TeamEnergy{P,G,B,R,Y,C} into +28, relays it, and updates the layout and vectors.
